statusDefinitions.live: Available on at least one listed production product surface.
statusDefinitions.beta: Available to an opt-in, cohort, or sandbox with documented limits.
statusDefinitions.partner-preview: Deployed for qualified personal-workspace partners; not a general-availability claim.
statusDefinitions.deployment-specific: Available only through an Integration Gateway operated for your deployment.
statusDefinitions.qualification-preview: Source and deployment exist, but authenticated production qualification is still incomplete.

developerServices.name: Execution Fabric
developerServices.summary: Submit, inspect, stream, and cancel durable tasks through the v1 API.

developerServices.name: Integration Gateway missions
developerServices.surface: REST API through the SDK, CLI, or MCP host
developerServices.summary: Create governed missions with budgets, signals, resumable events, and cancellation.

developerServices.name: TypeScript SDK
developerServices.auth: Short-lived delegated OAuth token for Gateway calls
developerServices.summary: Use typed mission, event, capability, trace, skill, and memory contracts from Node.js.

developerServices.name: Praxa CLI
developerServices.auth: OAuth token for Gateway commands; none for version and local planning
developerServices.summary: Inspect versions, diagnose a Gateway, operate missions, and plan memory sources from a terminal or CI job.

developerServices.name: MCP contracts
developerServices.auth: None for contract inspection; delegated OAuth for runtime calls
developerServices.summary: Register 12 stable Aura-compatible wire tools in an MCP-compatible host.

developerServices.name: Memory federation
developerServices.auth: Caller-owned provider clients in your backend
developerServices.summary: Query Mem0, LangGraph, Zep, Graphiti, Letta, OpenAI Agents, and custom sources without migrating first.

developerServices.name: Hosted memory candidates
developerServices.auth: Personal workspace API key with memory:read or memory:write
developerServices.summary: Stage portable, subject-scoped candidates for lexical query, export, and content-erasing deletion.

developerServices.name: Signed webhooks
developerServices.auth: Scoped personal workspace authority plus endpoint signing secret
developerServices.summary: Receive run lifecycle notifications, verify the raw body, and deduplicate retries.

developerServices.name: Events, usage, and observability
developerServices.surface: SSE, run readback, usage API, and webhook receipts
developerServices.auth: Personal workspace API key or deployment-issued OAuth token, depending on surface
developerServices.summary: Reconnect to event streams, inspect terminal state, and reconcile usage without treating admission as completion.

developerServices.name: API Playground
developerServices.auth: A disposable credential that you supply for the selected public contract
developerServices.summary: Build and inspect Execution Fabric and hosted-memory requests directly from the documentation.
